text.text_excerpt: I LOVE THIS PLACE . PERIODT. this black owned establishment provides a healthy option for the people of New Orleans East were unfortunately trapped in a blatant and obvious food desert. I've ordered many salads from them but my almost favorite is there salmon salad with ranch dressing. The portion of me is always enough in their presentation says my taste buds over the edge every time. Although still considered "fast food", this place tends to have longer to get time so be sure to order over the phone before you arrive to ensure you can eat then return to work on time. Overall, I would highly recommend.

Three words come to mind for this haven in the East: Simple, Healthy, & Delicious. The East isn't entirely devoid of good eats (po'boys, seafood, Vietnamese, sould food, etc.) , but this place sticks out as a unique option. I work nearby and often want to keep it light for lunch without having to sacrifice flavor. Salads Galore is perfect for this! My favorites are their shrimp wrap and their blackened salmon sandwich (can also get the blackened salmon in a salad). If you want to heartier, they have a variety of baked potatoes dressed up with other ingredients. I haven't tried any of the spud options yet but everything has looked great. The staff has always been friendly and helpful. Chec...

Happy New Year!!! Found a GEM in NO East named Salad Galore. Y'all know I'm about black owned so I had to try them out. Not only is this a black owned restaurant, it's one of the healthiest spots in the East! They have things from salads, wraps and baked potatoes. I decided to get the salmon salad and a basic spud (not pictured). Imma just say that salmon was cookedt to the T baybeee you hear me! Very seasoned and well cooked .... not to dry or undercooked. I will def be back to try damn near the whole menu. So next time your in New Orleans East make sure you pull up to Salad Galore!
